name: Palar

sink.name: Near Vayalur
sink.location: Chengalpattu district, Tamil Nadu, Bay of Bengal

did_you_know: 'Palar' means 'river of milk' in Tamil, but the river runs as an underground stream (Guptagamini) for a long stretch near its source before re-emerging near Bethamangala.
Water diverted from the Palar has historically fed the Poondi and Chembarambakkam reservoirs, once among Chennai's primary drinking-water sources.
Its banks host major historic temple towns, including Kanchipuram, though the tannery industry clustered along its middle course has long been a source of pollution concern.
